info.title: Storeware API
info.description: The API Storeware apps call with the token a shop gave them. Each call needs every permission it lists under `x-storeware-scopes`; a `:write` permission covers its `:read`. A call marked `x-storeware-app-only` is one an app makes about itself, and answers only an app’s token.

tags.name: Products
tags.description: The catalogue: products, their media and their fields.

tags.name: Variants
tags.description: The versions of a product a shopper buys, and their options.

tags.name: Collections
tags.description: Groups of products, set by hand or by rules.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: Stock at each location, and the locations themselves.

tags.name: Shipping
tags.description: The groups a shop sorts its goods into for delivery.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Orders, their payments, fulfillments, refunds and changes.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: What the shop holds, and the money sent to its bank.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: The shop’s customers and what is kept about them.

tags.name: Metafields
tags.description: The typed fields a shop and its apps keep on records.

tags.name: App billing
tags.description: What a shop pays your app: plans, one time charges and use.

tags.name: App settings
tags.description: What a merchant set for your app, and pictures your components show.

tags.name: App automations
tags.description: Triggers your app fires into a shop’s automations, and the menu they are built from.

get.description: A page of the catalogue, newest first unless `sort` says otherwise. Archived products are left out unless `status` asks for them or `ids` names them. `meta.total` counts every match.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Words in the title, handle or vendor, or a SKU.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma separated product ids, 100 at most: these and no others, in any state.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Newest first when not given. An order it does not know is ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many to return, up to 250. Fifty when not given, or every product `ids` names.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: How many to skip, for the next page.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Only the products one figure counts: `out_of_stock`, `never_read`, or `sold_30d` (needs `analytics:read`). One it does not know is ignored.

total.description: How many match, across every page.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Makes a variant for every combination of the options, or one variant when there are none, and gives each the `price`. It is a draft unless `status` says otherwise, and its handle comes from the title when none is given. Up to 3 options and 200 variants (`too_many_variants`).

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: Four figures over the catalogue, leaving out archived products: drafts, out of stock, never read by the shop, and sold in the last thirty days. Each but the first counts what the list’s matching `filter` returns.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: The product with its options, its variants and each variant’s prices.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent, and a null empties a field that may be empty. A new `handle` leaves a redirect from the old address. Variants, options and images have calls of their own.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

delete.description: Archives the product rather than deleting it, so past orders still point at it. Its `status` becomes `archived` and lists leave it out. Archiving it again answers `product_not_found`.

204.description: Done, with nothing to send back.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.summary: Get a product’s sales by day
get.description: Units of this product ordered on each of the last 30 days, oldest first and today last, counting orders that are still sales.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Makes a draft copy with the same words, options, variants, prices, pictures, custom data, translations and manual collections. SKUs and barcodes are left empty and stock starts at zero. Reviews, sales history, subscription plans and download files stay with the original. Send an `Idempotency-Key` so that a retry makes one copy.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: The product’s gallery in order, each image with its address. The first is the cover.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.summary: Add an image to a product
post.description: Puts an image already uploaded to the shop at the end of the product’s gallery, and answers with the whole gallery. Adding one already there changes nothing.

mediaId.description: An image uploaded to the shop.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Takes the whole gallery as a list of image ids, the cover first. Ids not on the product are ignored, and images left out keep their order behind the rest.

mediaIds.description: Every image, in the order wanted.

204.description: Done, with nothing to send back.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.summary: Add an option to a product
post.description: Adds an option such as Colour, with the value every existing variant takes: each variant’s title gains that value and nothing else changes. Add more values with `addOptionValue`. Refused with `option_name_taken` for a name the product already has, and `option_not_addable` when it has 3 options.

value.description: What every variant the product already has is in it: `Navy`.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

patch.description: Changes an option’s name. Variant titles are made of values alone, so none of them change. Answers with the whole product.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.summary: Add a value to an option
post.description: Adds the value, and a variant for it with each combination of the other options. The new variants copy their prices from the variant that differs only in this option, and start with no stock. Up to 50 values and 200 variants. Answers with the whole product.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

patch.description: Changes a value’s wording and retitles the variants that carry it, except one whose title was set by hand. Answers with the whole product.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

delete.description: Deletes the value and every variant that carries it, stock included. Refused with `option_value_sold` when any of those variants is on an order, and `last_option_value` for an option’s only value. Answers with the whole product.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: Up to 24 products by id, in the order asked, each with its price in the shop’s currency and its first pictures. An id that is not one of the shop’s products is left out rather than refused, and with no `ids` the list is empty.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma separated product ids, 24 at most.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Makes a product with one variant, its pictures, a price and a count, then puts it on sale last when `status` is `active`, so a shopper never meets it half made. Refused before anything is written with `listing_needs_price` (on sale with no price) or `listing_needs_shelf` (a count in a shop with no location of its own).

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: One rule across up to 250 products, in the shop’s own currency: a new price, a percentage up or down, or an amount up or down, with an optional `endIn` (99 for .99). Without `apply` nothing is written and every variant’s price before and after comes back. With `apply: true` they are written together, each kept in the variant’s price history as a bulk change. A "was" price the new price reaches is removed. Refused whole, with nothing written, when any price would come to nothing or less (`bulk_price_refused`).

changed.description: How many prices moved, or would.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Names, prices and counts up to 24 products of one variant each, and puts on sale those marked `publish`. Each entry is done on its own and one refusal does not stop the rest, so read every outcome rather than taking a 200 as all done. An entry is refused with `listing_needs_price`, `listing_needs_shelf` or `listing_has_options`.

status.description: What it is now, whether or not everything asked was done. Null if never read.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Answers a question the way the shop answers an AI shopper: only live products, in the order one is given them, with what the shop understood the question to mean. Nothing is recorded as a question the shop was asked. Each shop may try 10 questions a minute and 60 an hour, counted together for everybody on it. Past that it answers 429 `rate_limited`, with `Retry-After` saying how many seconds to wait.

query.description: The question, as an AI shopper might ask it.

rank.description: 1 for the first product an AI shopper is shown.

available.description: How many can be bought now.

query.description: The need, with the parts read as filters taken out.

maxPrice.description: A ceiling it read, in minor units.

minPrice.description: A floor it read, in minor units.

filtered.description: Found and then left out, usually for price or stock.

degraded.description: True when the question could not be read and this is a plain match.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: Every metafield value set on a product, each with its definition.

label.description: The merchant’s name for the field.

type.description: single_line_text, multi_line_text, integer, decimal, boolean, date, url and the other definition types.

value.description: The value, or a list of values when `isList`.

displayValue.description: The value as one line of text, lists joined.

source.description: Who set it: the merchant, an import, or an app’s slug.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

put.description: Sets up to 25 values in one call. A null value clears its field; keys not named are left alone. An app may set only the fields its manifest declares.

label.description: The merchant’s name for the field.

type.description: single_line_text, multi_line_text, integer, decimal, boolean, date, url and the other definition types.

value.description: The value, or a list of values when `isList`.

displayValue.description: The value as one line of text, lists joined.

source.description: Who set it: the merchant, an import, or an app’s slug.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: Every translated field, by locale.

data.description: Locale, then field, then the translated text.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

put.description: Sets translated fields for one locale. Fields not named are left alone, and a null clears one.

data.description: The locale’s fields after the change.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.summary: Read what every variant of a product holds
get.description: Stock, downloads, own pictures and custom data for each variant of one product, in one call. A variant with nothing recorded comes back with empty lists, so each variant has an entry, in the order the product lists them.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent, and a null clears a field that may be empty. A digital variant cannot also require shipping, so send `isDigital` true with `requiresShipping` false. Refused with `variant_sku_taken` for a SKU another variant has. Price, cost and back orders have calls of their own.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Sets or replaces the price in one currency, in minor units. A `compareAtAmount` is shown struck through and must be higher than the price (`invalid_compare_at_price`); leaving it out removes one already set. Every change is kept in the price history.

204.description: Done, with nothing to send back.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: Every price the variant has had, newest first, each with the one before it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many to return, up to 200. Twenty when not given.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Only changes in this currency, such as `GBP`.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Restores the price, and its compare-at price, from before one change in the price history. The revert is a change of its own and appears in the history. Refused with `nothing_to_revert` for a variant’s first price.

historyId.description: The `id` of the change to undo, from the history.

204.description: Done, with nothing to send back.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.summary: Set what a variant cost to buy
post.description: Sets the cost of one, in minor units, or clears it with a body of `null`, which means unknown. Shoppers never see it and no webhook carries it; it is read back as each variant’s `cost` on the product.

204.description: Done, with nothing to send back.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.summary: Set whether a variant sells with no stock
post.description: With `allow` true the variant keeps selling once its stock reaches zero; with false it stops there.

204.description: Done, with nothing to send back.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: The images shown when a shopper picks this variant, in order. A variant with none shows the product’s gallery.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.summary: Show an image for a variant
post.description: Adds an image already uploaded to the shop, usually one in the product’s gallery, to the variant’s own images. It is not added to the gallery. Adding one already there changes nothing.

mediaId.description: An image uploaded to the shop.

204.description: Done, with nothing to send back.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

delete.summary: Take an image off a variant
delete.description: Takes the image off the variant’s own images and leaves the image itself alone. The id goes in the query string.

204.description: Done, with nothing to send back.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: The files a buyer of this variant may download, oldest first.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.summary: Attach a download to a variant
post.description: Records a file uploaded with a ticket from `POST /digital-assets/upload-url`, by its `storagePath`, so every later buyer of the variant may download it. It does not make the variant digital: a book with a bonus file is still posted. When the file is all a buyer gets, set `isDigital` with `updateVariant`.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: Every collection, or a page of them when any of `search`, `kind`, `sort`, `limit` or `offset` is given. A page carries `meta.total` and, in `meta.counts`, how many products each collection on it holds.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Words in the title or handle.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: By title unless `updated_desc`, most recently changed first. Any other value is ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many to return. Fifty when not given.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: How many to skip, for the next page.

counts.description: Products in each collection on this page, by id.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.
An error. See the `type` for which.
An error. See the `type` for which.

delete.description: Deletes the collection and says what it touched. Its products are kept, and its children move to the top level.

productsUnlinked.description: Products that were in it. The products are untouched.

childrenPromoted.description: Child collections moved to the top level.

menuItemsRemoved.description: Menu entries that pointed at it.

discountTargetsRemoved.description: Discounts that named it, which now apply to less.

get.description: A page of the products in the collection, in its own order. Pass `meta.next` back as `after` for the next page.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma separated product ids: which of these are in it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many to return. Fifty when not given.

total.description: Members the search and ids match.

next.description: Pass back as `after`. Null on the last page.

truncated.description: True when a price sort was cut short at its cap.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Adds products to a manual collection. Products already in it are left where they are.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

delete.summary: Remove a product from a collection

get.description: One row per variant of every product not archived, with what is on hand, held and left to sell, added up across locations or read for one. `low` is five or fewer left; a variant that is not tracked is never low or out. `meta.counts` says how many of each there are under the same search.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Words in a product’s name, a variant’s name or a SKU.

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: One location. Every location added up when not given.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many to return, up to 250. Fifty when not given.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: How many to skip, for the next page.

tracked.description: False for a variant that carries on selling when it runs out, or is a download.

reserved.description: Held for orders placed and not yet sent.

total.description: How many match the filter and search, across every page.

counts.description: How many of each `filter` there are under the same search.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: For each variant named, what is on order from vendors and what is in transit between the shop’s locations. None of it is stock that can be sold. Every variant asked about is answered, with zeros when nothing is coming.

parameters.name: variantIds
parameters.description: Comma separated variant ids, up to 500.

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: Only what is coming to this location.

onOrder.description: Asked of a vendor and not yet delivered.

inTransit.description: Sent from another of the shop’s locations and not yet arrived.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: The variant’s level at each location that has one. A location that has never held it has no row: see `getVariantStock` for every location.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Send `delta` to add or take away, or `onHand` to set the shelf to a count, never both. Stock cannot fall below zero, nor below what is held for orders. A location kept by a supplier cannot be changed. A delta sent twice is applied twice, so send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make a retry safe.

delta.description: How many to add, or take away when negative.

onHand.description: What was counted on the shelf.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: Every change to the variant’s stock, newest first: what changed, by how much, what it left, and why where somebody said. Pass `meta.next` back as `before` for the next page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many to return, up to 200. Fifty when not given.

id.description: A 64 bit number, sent as a string.

kind.description: opening, adjustment, count, reserved, released, shipped, received, returned, transfer_out or transfer_in.

referenceType.description: What it was for, such as an order or a transfer.

next.description: Pass back as `before`. Null on the last page.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.summary: Get a variant’s stock at every location
get.description: The variant, and a row for each of the shop’s locations, including those that hold none of it, default first.

tracked.description: False for a variant that carries on selling when it runs out, or is a download.

kind.description: `supplier` stock is refreshed from the supplier and cannot be changed here.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: Every place the shop keeps stock.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: With `isDefault`, the new location becomes the one orders take their stock from, in place of the old default.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

patch.description: Renames it, or makes it the default, which moves where every later order takes its stock from. The default cannot be turned off, only moved.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: Every class the shop has, oldest first. A class holds variants that cost the same to send, and a delivery rate can name classes to depend on. `meta.gaps` lists the delivery zones with no rate for a class that has variants in it, because a basket holding one of those cannot be checked out to that zone.

gaps.description: Class id to the ids of the zones with no rate for it.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Answers with the class already holding that name, unchanged, if there is one. Refused with `shipping_class_name_invalid` for a name with no letter or number in it. Send `Idempotency-Key` to make a retry safe.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

patch.description: Changes only the fields sent. Renaming a class keeps its slug. Refused with `shipping_class_not_found` for a class this shop does not have.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

delete.description: The variants in it are left in no class. Refused with `shipping_class_in_use` while a delivery rate names it, because the rate would then be offered to the wrong baskets.

variantsCleared.description: How many variants were left in no class.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: A page of orders, newest first unless `sort` says otherwise. `meta.units` says, for each order on the page, how many units were ordered and how many have been sent; `meta.labelled` names the ones with a postage label bought.

parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: `to_send`: paid for and not all sent, and not on hold. `on_hold`: kept back by the shop.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: An order number, with or without the `#`, matched exactly; or words in the buyer’s email or name.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Placed on or after this day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in the shop’s own time.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Placed on or before this day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, in the shop’s own time.

parameters.name: payment
parameters.description: How it was paid, in the words of the export’s Financial Status column.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Carrying any of these tags, separated by commas.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many to return, up to 250. Fifty when not given.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: How many to skip, for the next page.

total.description: How many match, across every page.

units.description: Units ordered and sent, by order id, for the orders on this page.

labelled.description: The orders on this page with a bought, unvoided label going out.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: The order with its lines and its adjustments. With `format=acp`, the same order in the Agentic Commerce Protocol’s shape instead.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `acp` for the Agentic Commerce Protocol’s shape.

adjustments.description: Refunds, store credit, returns and disputes, newest first.

invoicePaid.description: On an order placed on account, whether the money has arrived.

cardLeft.description: What a refund still sends back the way it was paid.

creditLeft.description: What goes back to store credit after that.

refundWays.description: For an order store credit or a gift card paid some of. Null for any other order.

checkout_session_id.description: Empty when no checkout session placed it.

permalink_url.description: The order’s page at the shop.

title.description: The product’s title, and the variant’s in parentheses.

anyOf.description: With `format=acp`: the order in the Agentic Commerce Protocol’s shape.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

delete.description: Cancels the order and puts back the stock not yet sent. It refunds nothing: refund it separately. Cancelling an order already cancelled changes nothing. Emits `order.canceled.v1`.

reason.description: Why, kept on the order’s history.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

patch.summary: Correct an order’s contact details or address
patch.description: Corrects the buyer’s email, name or phone, or the delivery address. Never moves money: tax stays as charged, and a difference in delivery is settled by editing the order. Refused for an order wholly sent, one with a live label or a supplier, and for a paid order moving to another country. Changing the email does not change whose order it is, and the old address is told.

fields.description: Which fields would change, by name.

charged.description: What was charged for delivery, in minor units.

quoted.description: What this address would come to, in minor units.

digest.description: Pass this as `acknowledged` when there are notices.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.summary: List orders waiting on a card check
get.description: Orders whose payment is held for a card issuer’s check (such as 3D Secure) that the buyer has not finished, the link soonest to expire first. The links themselves are never listed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many to return. Fifty when not given.

sessionId.description: The checkout session. Renew its link with this id.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working. Null once it is opened.

state.description: `outstanding`: nobody has opened the link. `expired`: nobody opened it in time. `opened`: the buyer is answering the challenge now.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Makes a new link for a buyer to finish their card check, and answers with it. The new link replaces the old one, which stops working. Whoever holds the link can pay for and then read the order, so send it only to the buyer and do not store it. Refused for a checkout that is not waiting on a check.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.summary: Approve or reject a held order
post.description: Answers an order an AI agent placed above the shop’s approval limit, which waits in `manual_review`. Approving takes the payment, which is the first time money moves, so it can fail as any payment can; it answers the order and anything the payment still needs. Rejecting cancels the order, puts its stock back and emits `order.canceled.v1`; it answers the order.

reason.description: Why it was rejected. Read only when rejecting.

payment.description: Present when the payment is waiting on a browser.

amount.description: What the card is asked for, in minor units.

authentication.description: Present when the card issuer wants the buyer, and a link must be sent to them.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: Every change proposed or made to the order since it was placed, oldest first.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.summary: Confirm, decline or cancel an order change
post.description: Settles a pending change. Confirming moves the stock and the money and emits `order.changed.v1`: a change that gives money back refunds it to the card, and one that leaves the customer owing more is recorded as owed, not charged. A change that would refund an order paid in stablecoins, imported from another platform, or not yet paid for is refused. Declining or cancelling closes it with nothing moved.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

post.description: Adds one action to a pending change: add a variant, change a line’s quantity, remove a line, or add or take off delivery. Checked against the order as it stands now. Amounts are in minor units.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

delete.summary: Remove a line from an order change
delete.description: Takes an action off a change nobody has confirmed yet.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

downloadLimit.description: How many downloads in all. Null for unlimited.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

Emits `fulfillment.updated.v1`, and `delivered` writes to the buyer. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make a retry safe: a second request with the same key answers what the first did.

free.description: Units not sent yet and not held by a label still being bought.

weightGrams.description: One unit. Null when the product has no weight.

blocked.description: Why label buying is paused on the account, if it is.

international.description: Whether the parcel crosses a border and needs customs.

chosen.description: The delivery the shopper paid for, when they chose one.

shipmentId.description: Send it back, with a `rateId`, to buy.

rateId.description: What a label is bought with.

amount.description: The carrier’s price, in minor units.

postage.description: The carrier’s price, in minor units.

fee.description: Card processing on the whole charge, in minor units.

price.description: What the card would be charged.

payOnUse.description: A return label charged only when a carrier first scans it.

refusal.description: Why the carrier offered nothing, when it did not.

chosenServiceToken.description: The service the shopper paid for, when it is among the rates.

checked.description: False when nobody was asked. That is not a verdict.

messages.description: The carrier’s own sentences about the address.

suggestion.description: The address as the carrier writes it.

customs.description: What the parcel declares to customs. Null when it crosses no border.

Send the same `purchaseKey` again, or resume the label, to carry on; it never buys twice.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

delete.description: Lets the order be sent again. An order that was not held is left as it is.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.description: For the controls that narrow the list. The commonest first, at most a hundred.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

Refused for an order imported from another platform, one paid in stablecoins, one whose payment has not completed, and an amount past what is left. Emits `order.refunded.v1`. default.description: An error. See the `type` for which.

get.summary: Get your app’s billing on this shop
get.description: The plan in force, this period’s usage, a cheaper plan waiting to start, the charges waiting for the merchant, the one-time charges approved among your last 50, and the plans your installed release declares, priced in the shop’s currency.

currency.description: The shop’s billing currency. Every amount here is in its minor unit: cents, pence, paise.

usage.description: Only on a plan that charges by use.

scheduled.description: A cheaper plan the merchant approved, to start when this period ends.

post.summary: Ask the merchant to approve a plan
post.description: Asks for one of the plans your installed release declares. Send the merchant to `confirmationUrl`: nothing is charged until they approve, and they have 48 hours to. `returnUrl` must be https on your app’s own address (its `app.url`, webhook URL or a redirect URI). Asking for the plan already in force answers with it and changes nothing. At most 5 charges may wait for an answer at once. Send the same `idempotencyKey` again and you are answered with the first result, so a retry never charges twice.

Send the same `idempotencyKey` again and you are answered with the first result, so a retry never charges twice.

Send the same `idempotencyKey` again and you are answered with the first result, so a retry never charges twice.

available.description: False when the order does not entitle anyone, or the allowance is spent.

unavailableReason.description: Why not, in English, for the customer.

requestId.description: Quote it when asking for help.

sourceKey.description: The carrier’s name for the scan. Null for one a person recorded.

reserved.description: Held for orders placed and not yet sent.

available.description: On hand less reserved: what can still be sold.

variants.description: How many variants it has. More than one means options, each with its own price.

amount.description: In the currency’s minor units, such as pence.

price.description: Its price in the shop’s currency, when it has one variant and that is priced.

madeToOrder.description: Whether it keeps selling with none in stock.

pictures.description: Its first three pictures, the cover first, sized for a small tile.

isDefault.description: Orders take their stock from the default location. A shop has one.

address.description: Where a carrier collects from. Null until somebody gives one.

addressValidatedAt.description: When a carrier last agreed the address exists. Null is unchecked.

kind.description: `supplier` stock is refreshed from the supplier and cannot be changed here.

supplierConnectionId.description: The supplier that stocks it. Null for the shop’s own.

pluginId.description: The app whose manifest declares it. Null for the shop’s own field.

ownerType.description: The kind of record it hangs on.

namespace.description: `custom` unless said. Namespaces starting `app_` belong to apps.

isList.description: Holds a list of values rather than one.

choices.description: The only values it may hold.

validations.description: The rules every value is checked against.

storefrontVisible.description: Shoppers may see it. Never true on a customer or an order.

searchFacet.description: Shoppers can narrow search by it.

position.description: Where it sits among the fields for its kind of record, lowest first.

buyerProven.description: Whether the basket named a known customer when the order was placed. False for an order filed under an email address someone typed.

orderNumber.description: The number the shop and the buyer know it by, without the `#`.

customerNote.description: What the shopper wrote at checkout.

locale.description: The language the shopper was reading the shop in. Null when the shop never knew.

fulfillmentOption.description: The delivery the shopper chose, by name. Null on older orders.

discountAmount.description: Everything discounts took off, including any taken off delivery.

companyId.description: The trade account it was placed against, if any.

paymentTermsNetDays.description: Days to pay, for an order placed on account. Null when paid at checkout.

dueAt.description: When an order on account falls due.

changeAmount.description: The net of every confirmed change, signed: positive means the customer owes more.

creditAppliedAmount.description: The part of the total paid with store credit.

tags.description: Labels the shop put on the order. Staff only, never shown to a shopper.

heldAt.description: When the shop kept this order back from being sent. Null when it may go.

holdReason.description: Why it was kept back. Staff only, never shown to a shopper.

subscriptionId.description: The subscription that produced it. Null for a one time purchase.

providerRefundId.description: The payment provider’s id for the refund, when one was sent.

evidenceDueBy.description: On a dispute: when the answer is due.

feeAmount.description: On a dispute: what it cost, in minor units of `feeCurrency`. Null until the payment provider states it.

feeCurrency.description: On a dispute: the currency of `feeAmount`.

actorType.description: Who issued it. Null for a refund the payment provider reported.

deltaTotalAmount.description: What the change came to, signed and in minor units: positive means the customer owes more. Zero until it is confirmed, as are the other deltas.

adjustmentId.description: The refund it made, when it gave money back.

quantityDelta.description: Signed. Negative takes units off the line.

title.description: The product’s title when it was bought.

variantTitle.description: The variant’s title when it was bought.

quantityReturned.description: Units that came back, whatever the shopper got for them.

unitAmount.description: One unit, in minor units of the order’s currency.

discountAmount.description: The line’s share of the discounts.

connected.description: False for a shop with no payment account yet.

live.description: False when the balance and the list could not be read just now. They are then empty, and `failure` is still current.
